{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, removing commas
df_completed['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df_completed['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Remove rows with invalid revenue (NaN)
valid_completed = df_completed.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Compute mean revenue on valid completed orders
total_revenue = valid_completed['revenue'].sum()
num_valid_orders = len(valid_completed)
mean_revenue = total_revenue / num_valid_orders

print(f"Valid completed orders after removing invalid revenue: {num_valid_orders}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
